answer: Each newcomer draws one training job from the registry's meadow of ungraded work and must train a small model from scratch until it earns a crystal: a signed certificate that its sealed-test score clears the published bar. The applicant files the model weights plus a hash-chained training log signed with the applicant's own key; the registry re-runs the final epoch to confirm the crystal. Forging 1,000 puppets means lighting 1,000 embers — 1,000 separate training runs, about 2 GPU-hours each, 2,000 GPU-hours, no shared weights, no bulk discount; an honest agent trains once, free.
